rules: Replay is one legacy record at a time.
The server derives the target event kind from the approved surface.
The raw legacy record id is hashed and is not stored as progression evidence.
The canonical source must pass the normal World source authority.
Reward amounts come only from the normal server-owned World reward catalogue.
Different legacy ids pointing at the same canonical reward source must still mint at most once.
Unsupported or aggregate legacy surfaces fail closed.
